sources.title: Google's AlphaGo AI defeats human in first game of Go contest
sources.excerpt: an achievement many thought was at least a decade away

reasoning: The claim is completely accurate. In March 2016, DeepMind's AlphaGo played a historic five-game match against Lee Sedol, one of the greatest Go players of the modern era, and won 4-1. Prior to AlphaGo's breakthrough (beginning with its victory over Fan Hui in late 2015), AI experts and Go players widely believed that a computer beating a top-tier professional Go player was at least a decade away due to the immense complexity of the game.
